items.name: Vellatrix
items.description: This exquisite rapier was originally crafted in Cheliax for the renowned duelist Seraphina Vellatrix. Its blade is etched with intricate infernal runes, a testament to its Chelish origin, and the hilt is adorned with dark, gleaming gemstones. The weapon mysteriously resurfaced in the Shackles, wielded by a notorious merchant ship captain who was feared for her unmatched prowess in both combat and negotiation.
